pr_body:
Change return type of `AStarGrid2D.get_id_path` from `PackedVector2Array` to `TypedArray<Vector2i>` to be consistent with the grid ID type - which is `Vector2i`.

Fixes #66541

issue_context.title: `AStarGrid2D.get_id_path` returns `Vector2`s instead of `Vector2i`s
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4.0.dev (7f113042c0)

### System information

Linux, Vulkan API 1.2.131 - Using Vulkan Device #1: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960M

### Issue description

Just as the title says, `AStarGrid2D.get_id_path` returns a `PackedVector2Array`, but the IDs of individual points are actually `Vector2i`s.

Because no `PackedVector2iArray` exists in Godot (see https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/5486) the ID is converted from `Vector2i` to `Vector2` internally. To get the ID in GDScript you would have to convert it back. This is an unnecessary inconvenience and inefficiency that should be fixed.

A `PackedVector2iArray` type should be added to core and the function result type changed accordingly.

review_comments:
`Vector2`s are OK here, because those are the actual path positions.

I can change it to `TypedArray` as well, but this is not necessary as it works as intended.
